response.original_title: 取引先の傲慢社長に中出しされ続けた出張接待。 専属美女、イイ女のスーツ『美』―。 水川スミレ
response.overview: Sumire is entrusted with a crucial business deal that will determine the company's fate and is sent on a business trip. The reason she was given this task... is because the client's president, Ozawa, is known as a womanizer and an arrogant man. He had planned to bring Sumire, the most beautiful woman in the company, along to secure the deal, but... When the reception begins, Sumire is forced into a humiliating sexual encounter in front of her boss, where her body is abused. She manages to survive the persistent sexual harassment and return to her accommodation, but Ozawa's sexual exploitation has only just begun...
response.tagline: Exclusive beauty, a gorgeous woman in a suit 'Beauty'
response.title: Business trip entertainment where I was repeatedly penetrated by the arrogant CEO of a client company.
